title: From information bounds to infrared gravity: implications of Sharma-Mittal entropy (Benkrane, Luciano, Sheykhi)
efc_relevance: Derives the Verlinde-style entropic gravitational force and acceleration laws induced by the two-parameter Sharma-Mittal (SM) generalised entropy, interpolating between Rényi and Bekenstein-Hawking limits, and incorporates Landauer's principle into the black-hole mass-loss relation. Direct ontological cousin of EFC: same Verlinde/Jacobson lineage and a parametric entropy family that contains EFC's information-entropy ansatz as a limit; the SM (q, r) plane is the natural background against which EFC's S(r,t) entropy must position itself.
ledger_action: Add to External Research Ledger under cluster emergent-entropic-gravity; cross-reference framework:VerlindeEntropic-2010, framework:Jacobson-1995, framework:KaniadakisHDE-Drepanou2021 and arXiv:2604.19831 (Van der Waals gravity); required WP1 recovery-conditions row mapping EFC's S(r,t) functional onto the SM (q, r) limit.
